title: Design System Starter Kit component manifest
description: Schema for manifest.json: the framework-agnostic register of every design system component. manifest.json is generated from one src/<dir>/<name>.manifest.json file per component, each of which is a #/$defs/component. Keep this schema in sync with manifest.d.ts, which describes the same structure for TypeScript consumers.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema, so editors pick up completion and validation.

version.description: Schema version of the manifest structure. Independent of the package version.

description.description: Explains what the manifest is and how to read it.

components.description: Every component in the design system, in no guaranteed order.

name.description: PascalCase component name, matching the React export and the Storybook title.

cssBlock.description: Primary BEM block class. Components that share a block (ButtonLink reuses dsn-button) repeat it here; their distinction is semantic, not visual.

category.description: Functional category, used for grouping and filtering.

purpose.description: One-sentence English description of what the component does.

platforms.description: Which platform implementations exist for this component.

primaryProps.description: The most important props an implementer needs. Not exhaustive: api.props holds the complete list where it exists, the component's .docs.md otherwise. An empty array means the component has no notable props.

name.description: Prop name as used in React (camelCase) or HTML (modifier suffix).

type.description: Type for props that are not enum-style. Use values instead for a fixed set of options.

default.description: Default value. Null means the prop is optional and has no default behaviour.

required.description: Whether the prop must be provided. Omitting it means optional.

api.description: The complete public API of the component, with how each part appears in Figma. Checked against the React props type and the Figma matrix of the component.

props.description: Every prop of the component, not only the primary ones. className is left out: every component has it.

slots.description: Named content areas in the markup. An empty array means the component has none.

states.description: Interaction states that come from the browser (pseudo-classes) rather than from a prop. An empty array means the component has none.

apiProp.description: One prop. Needs either figma or slots: a prop that fills a slot takes its Figma binding from that slot.

name.description: Prop name as used in React (camelCase).

type.description: Type for props that are not enum-style. Use values instead for a fixed set of options.

values.description: Allowed values for enum-style props, in the order of the TypeScript union.

default.description: Default value. Null means the prop is optional and has no default behaviour.

required.description: Whether the prop must be provided. Omitting it means optional.

native.description: True for a prop the component inherits from its element's React attributes (disabled, type, checked, children) instead of declaring it on its own props interface or on that of a component it extends.

slots.description: Names of the slots this prop fills.

name.description: Slot name in kebab-case. The Figma matrix marks the same element with data-figma-slot.

element.description: The class of the element that forms the slot.

description.description: What goes in the slot, in one sentence.

selector.description: The pseudo-class that triggers the state.

figmaBindings.description: How this part appears in the generated Figma component set. Use a single binding of kind none, with a reason, for a part that is deliberately left out of Figma.

kind.description: variant: an axis of the component set, or one value of it. boolean, text and instance-swap: a component property. slot: a Figma slot (data-figma-children in the matrix). none: not in Figma.

property.description: Name of the axis or component property in the Figma matrix. Required for every kind except none.

value.description: Variant bindings of props and states only: the one value on the axis this part stands for. A prop without value owns the whole axis.

reason.description: Why the part is not in Figma, or why it is bound the way it is. Required for kind none.

instance.description: For a component property that belongs to a nested, exposed instance rather than to this component set: the name of that nested component.

unset.description: Variant bindings of an enum prop without a default: the axis value that stands for the prop not being set (auto). It comes first on the axis, before the prop's values.

values.description: Variant bindings that own a whole axis: the axis values in Figma when they differ from what the prop implies, in axis order. Another spelling (16-9 for 16:9), a subset of an enum, labels for false and true of a boolean (with-border, no-border for noBorder), or for present and absent.

open.description: Something about this binding is not known yet: why the part is not in Figma (kind none), or what is missing from it (a subset of an enum). The reason says what. pnpm --filter @dsn-starter-kit/components-html report:figma-open lists every open binding.
